title: Remove alternator, A/C compressor, power steering pump, belt drive, AOS, water pump

notices.text: The AOS and its vent hoses come off as a unit — replace all of it, the hoses go brittle and crack and a vacuum leak there is a genuine engine-killer (it can hydro-lock or run the engine on its own oil). The water pump almost certainly has a plastic impeller; replace it with a metal-impeller unit on principle, because a shed plastic impeller distributes itself through the whole cooling system. Inspect the accessory belt tensioner and idler bearings by hand — any roughness, replace.

steps.text: Remove alternator, A/C compressor, power steering pump, belt drive, AOS, water pump.

fasteners.name: Water pump bolts
fasteners.note: New gasket; do not over-torque into the aluminium case.

sources.ref: WSM Gr.1 Part 1 (M96/01 edition) p.1-2, 1-5 (coolant pump to crankcase)
Knowledge Gruppe, Fastening Specifications 996, p.19 item 23 (oil separator to crankcase, M6 x 16); WSM Gr.1 Part 1 (M96/01 edition) p.1-1
